name: The Crane
hint: No push can lift a crate. A pan can — if it's loaded before the other side is.
catch: no push ever lifts a crate — but a pan can. Park the upstairs crate on its pan while the pan is level, THEN weigh the downstairs pan with two crates: the crate rides up to the spring's height and you can tip it in. In the wrong order the raised pan takes no crate (and a loaded crate sinks its pan, lifting the far one out of reach).
